Characters

Tap a character to load it into the box.

Character colors

Parts with the same or a very similar color (just a bit lighter or darker) print with one filament (one AMS slot). Colors with a different tint, like pale blue and white, stay separate. Pick the same swatch for both if you want them on one filament.

Extras
Box color
Box shapeClassic

Rounded softens the outside corners. The size, switch mount and fit stay the same.

“Made with Boxedables” under the box
Keychain hook

A loop on the back of the box, near the top, with a 4 mm hole for a key ring. Its underside is angled, so it prints upright with the box without supports.

Box tape

The strip of tape over the top of the front wall.

Texture
Smooth label behind the name

The walls themselves are sculpted, in the box color. The texture fades to smooth around the name, icon, pattern, logo, hook and latch. The inside, rim and floor stay smooth, so the character still clicks in the same way.
